summary: GASP is Epic's Gameplay Animation Sample. It shows Motion Matching locomotion driven by Speed and a trajectory.
detail: The animation database chooses the next pose. Gameplay writes Speed and Aiming. GASP should not trace to rediscover a gait the input graph already wrote.
definition: GASP is Epic's Gameplay Animation Sample. It shows Motion Matching locomotion driven by Speed and a trajectory. The animation database chooses the next pose. Gameplay writes Speed and Aiming. GASP should not trace to rediscover a gait the input graph already wrote.

summary: A Chaos Field pushes or breaks a Geometry Collection without a Tick that moves every shard.
detail: Fields are the force or the strain you apply to a collection. The collection owns the shards. A field is the event that strains them.
definition: A Chaos Field pushes or breaks a Geometry Collection without a Tick that moves every shard. Fields are the force or the strain you apply to a collection. The collection owns the shards. A field is the event that strains them.

summary: Throttle is the vehicle's own axis. It is not the on-foot Speed of 600.
detail: IA_Throttle writes Throttle on the authority. Copying a sprint speed into Throttle launches the car at a number that means a gait, not an engine.
definition: Throttle is the vehicle's own axis. It is not the on-foot Speed of 600. IA_Throttle writes Throttle on the authority. Copying a sprint speed into Throttle launches the car at a number that means a gait, not an engine.

summary: Suspension is the spring and damper on each wheel. The simulation rebuilds it from throttle and the ground.
detail: Wheel transforms are local. Replicating each wheel is the expensive reading of a pose the client can integrate from Throttle.
definition: Suspension is the spring and damper on each wheel. The simulation rebuilds it from throttle and the ground. Wheel transforms are local. Replicating each wheel is the expensive reading of a pose the client can integrate from Throttle.

summary: Artillery is a fire mission that spends a shell on the authority. It does not lift fog.
detail: The shell budget stops a click from streaming impacts. A spotter's vision pass reveals the cell. The gun is not the eyes.
definition: Artillery is a fire mission that spends a shell on the authority. It does not lift fog. The shell budget stops a click from streaming impacts. A spotter's vision pass reveals the cell. The gun is not the eyes.

summary: Ballistics is the shot after the trigger: the trace or the projectile, then heat and damage.
detail: Heat steps on the fire action. A miss can still heat the barrel. Damage waits for a hit. Tick should not add heat while the player is not firing.
definition: Ballistics is the shot after the trigger: the trace or the projectile, then heat and damage. Heat steps on the fire action. A miss can still heat the barrel. Damage waits for a hit. Tick should not add heat while the player is not firing.

summary: Hitscan resolves the shot on the same frame with a trace. There is no flying actor.
detail: The trace starts at the muzzle or the camera. A wall blocks it. Use a projectile when the round should travel and drop.
definition: Hitscan resolves the shot on the same frame with a trace. There is no flying actor. The trace starts at the muzzle or the camera. A wall blocks it. Use a projectile when the round should travel and drop.

summary: A projectile is a spawned actor that moves and hits later. Hitscan does not spawn one.
detail: Spawn it on the authority. Replicate the actor while it is relevant, not every pellet transform. Apply damage when it hits.
definition: A projectile is a spawned actor that moves and hits later. Hitscan does not spawn one. Spawn it on the authority. Replicate the actor while it is relevant, not every pellet transform. Apply damage when it hits.

summary: Recoil kicks the aim after a shot. It is a camera or muzzle offset, not a second trace.
detail: The fire action adds it. Recover it with a short timeline or a decay. Do not write it from Tick while the player is idle.
definition: Recoil kicks the aim after a shot. It is a camera or muzzle offset, not a second trace. The fire action adds it. Recover it with a short timeline or a decay. Do not write it from Tick while the player is idle.

summary: Spread is the cone around the aim. A shot picks a direction inside it.
detail: Aiming can tighten the cone. The cone is data on the weapon. The trace uses the chosen direction. It does not grow on Tick.
definition: Spread is the cone around the aim. A shot picks a direction inside it. Aiming can tighten the cone. The cone is data on the weapon. The trace uses the chosen direction. It does not grow on Tick.

summary: A fire mode is semi, burst, or auto. The trigger still starts the shot. The mode only decides how many.
detail: Put the mode on the weapon data. Do not build a second graph per mode. A timer inside the fire action spaces the burst.
definition: A fire mode is semi, burst, or auto. The trigger still starts the shot. The mode only decides how many. Put the mode on the weapon data. Do not build a second graph per mode. A timer inside the fire action spaces the burst.

summary: Reload moves rounds from the reserve into the magazine, and only when the action fires.
detail: Clamp the magazine to its size. A Tick that reloads itself fires during a weapon swap. The cap belongs on the weapon data.
definition: Reload moves rounds from the reserve into the magazine, and only when the action fires. Clamp the magazine to its size. A Tick that reloads itself fires during a weapon swap. The cap belongs on the weapon data.

summary: Ammo is the count in the gun and the count on the body. The mesh is not the state.
detail: Magazine and Reserve are the numbers worth replicating or saving. Spawning one actor per round replicates a mesh the count already describes.
definition: Ammo is the count in the gun and the count on the body. The mesh is not the state. Magazine and Reserve are the numbers worth replicating or saving. Spawning one actor per round replicates a mesh the count already describes.

summary: Scoring adds a value on the authority when a medal event runs. The board only reads it.
detail: A kill and a capture should not share one literal. The row owns the value. OnRep refreshes the board and does not add the points again.
definition: Scoring adds a value on the authority when a medal event runs. The board only reads it. A kill and a capture should not share one literal. The row owns the value. OnRep refreshes the board and does not add the points again.

summary: A Save Game is the object a slot stores. Pack the numbers the authority already wrote.
detail: Begin Play loads it. Do not write it from Tick, and do not pack derived poses, wheel transforms, or delegate bindings. Those rebuild.
definition: A Save Game is the object a slot stores. Pack the numbers the authority already wrote. Begin Play loads it. Do not write it from Tick, and do not pack derived poses, wheel transforms, or delegate bindings. Those rebuild.

summary: Dialogue reads a row and offers choices. The lines live in a table, not in the graph.
detail: A choice can require a flag. The conversation writes the flag. It does not own the whole quest. A local bool on the NPC is lost when the NPC despawns.
definition: Dialogue reads a row and offers choices. The lines live in a table, not in the graph. A choice can require a flag. The conversation writes the flag. It does not own the whole quest. A local bool on the NPC is lost when the NPC despawns.

summary: Sanity is a fear or stress number. Sight can raise it. A medkit or a safe room lowers it.
detail: Do not drain it on Tick if a timer already pulses the effect. The number is gameplay. The camera shake is the reaction.
definition: Sanity is a fear or stress number. Sight can raise it. A medkit or a safe room lowers it. Do not drain it on Tick if a timer already pulses the effect. The number is gameplay. The camera shake is the reaction.

summary: Stealth is staying out of sight and out of hearing. The hunter's sense is not the player's use trace.
detail: A glimpse on a timer can forgive a flicker. A loud sound calls the same sense event. Hiding is an interactable, not a second brain.
definition: Stealth is staying out of sight and out of hearing. The hunter's sense is not the player's use trace. A glimpse on a timer can forgive a flicker. A loud sound calls the same sense event. Hiding is an interactable, not a second brain.

summary: AI hearing is a noise event that reaches the same sense as sight. A bottle does not need its own AI.
detail: The sound reports a location and a loudness. The sense trace still checks the wall. Do not grow a second perception component for audio.
definition: AI hearing is a noise event that reaches the same sense as sight. A bottle does not need its own AI. The sound reports a location and a loudness. The sense trace still checks the wall. Do not grow a second perception component for audio.

summary: Fog of war is team vision. A timer reveals cells the unit can see. An order does not.
detail: Visible is not relevancy. Culling an actor must not delete a unit a spotter might reveal later. Clients do not write the bool.
definition: Fog of war is team vision. A timer reveals cells the unit can see. An order does not. Visible is not relevancy. Culling an actor must not delete a unit a spotter might reveal later. Clients do not write the bool.

summary: An economy is a stock the authority spends. The cost lives on a data row, not a literal.
detail: A barracks and a turret do not cost the same. Income is a slow timer, not Tick. The widget reads the number. It is not a second stock.
definition: An economy is a stock the authority spends. The cost lives on a data row, not a literal. A barracks and a turret do not cost the same. Income is a slow timer, not Tick. The widget reads the number. It is not a second stock.

summary: A build queue is the list of things the stock has paid for and not finished.
detail: The click spends once and enqueues. Tick should not spend again each frame. When the timer finishes, spawn the unit and pop the queue.
definition: A build queue is the list of things the stock has paid for and not finished. The click spends once and enqueues. Tick should not spend again each frame. When the timer finishes, spawn the unit and pop the queue.

summary: Niagara is Unreal's particle system. Spawn it at a location when a shot or an impact needs a burst.
detail: The system asset is the effect. The spawn is the event. Do not tick a new system every frame to keep a muzzle flash alive.
definition: Niagara is Unreal's particle system. Spawn it at a location when a shot or an impact needs a burst. The system asset is the effect. The spawn is the event. Do not tick a new system every frame to keep a muzzle flash alive.

summary: RTS selection marks which units receive the next order. The click does not search the whole level.
detail: Selected is a bool on the unit before the order runs. One interface serves a tank and a squad. The order does not reveal fog.
definition: RTS selection marks which units receive the next order. The click does not search the whole level. Selected is a bool on the unit before the order runs. One interface serves a tank and a squad. The order does not reveal fog.
